stories.title: Russia and Ukraine report progress in talks, but US points to lack of trust
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine both said some progress was made in the latest round of talks, Investing.com reported, though the US cited a lack of trust between the two sides. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said further progress depends on how the US approaches Russia.
stories.whyItMatters: The war remains a key source of the geopolitical risk premium priced into energy and commodity markets, so any shift toward or away from a deal can move oil and gas prices.
whatToWatch: Whether a further round of talks is scheduled
The US stance toward Russia that Zelenskiy says will shape progress
questions: What specifically has moved forward in the talks?
What would the US need to see to trust the process?
